org.name: Avon and Wiltshire Mental Health Partnership NHS Trust

hazard: Delayed resolution of outstanding safety issues

concerns.quote: The care and treatment provided by the Trust to Mr. Watkins should be reviewed at the earliest opportunity in the light of the findings of the jury at the Inquest and the Trust's own internal management report and root cause analysis report.
concerns.hazard: inadequate review of care and treatment

concerns.quote: The CQC should satisfy themselves that any and all deficiencies in the care provided to Mr. Watkins and generally on Aspen Ward have been identified and addressed.
concerns.hazard: unidentified deficiencies in care on Aspen Ward

concerns.quote: The CQC should satisfy themselves that an appropriate timetable and action plan are in place to ensure any outstanding issues on Aspen Ward relating to the safe care and treatment of service users are addressed at the earliest opportunity.
concerns.hazard: delayed resolution of outstanding safety issues

concerns.quote: The CQC should satisfy themselves that the arrangements and facilities for the provision of care and treatment of service users on Aspen Ward, now and in the future, are such as to ensure those service users can be provided with safe care and treatment.
concerns.hazard: inadequate arrangements and facilities for safe care

reports.title: Rebecca Romero
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: In this case there was confusion as to whether on an in-patient transfer there should be a Form 2 to go alongside the Form 1 procedure

Consideration should be given to ensuring that all care plans are time specific so that dates of meetings or dates for tasks to be completed are set at the time of the meeting so again expectations are managed and everyone knows exactly what the plan is and when actions will occur
That the issue of inconsistent terminology when assessing risk is reviewed to ensure a consistent approach
consideration should be given to training and/or guidance issued for staff communicating with young persons by text or any means of social media.
concerns.hazard: inadequate guidance on staff communication with young persons via text or social media

concerns.quote: Consideration should be given to reviewing whether there ought to be guidance issued when managing children who go out of area for psychiatric in patient care and further guidance issued in the management of children when returning to their local area when they have been an in-patient out of area
concerns.hazard: lack of guidance for out-of-area child psychiatric inpatient care and reintegration

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the need for timely planning and scheduling of care activities to ensure safety. They differ in focus: the earlier concerns a ward‑wide timetable and action plan, while the later stresses time‑specific care plans for individual patients.
links.earlier_quote: The CQC should satisfy themselves that an appropriate timetable and action plan are in place to ensure any outstanding issues on Aspen Ward relating to the safe care and treatment of service users are addressed at the earliest opportunity.
links.later_quote: Consideration should be given to ensuring that all care plans are time specific so that dates of meetings or dates for tasks to be completed are set at the time of the meeting so again expectations are managed and everyone knows exactly what the plan is and when actions will occur.
